fallback.criterion: no L<=6 achieves >=2/3 joint pass AND energy-best run passes
fallback.initialization: each seed's own L=6 output plus two independently sampled small layers uniform[-0.05,0.05]

connectivity: arbitrary NN/NNN ring logical edges, no routing or SWAP
compiler: each ZZ angle 2a => CNOT(control,target), RZ(2a,target), CNOT(control,target); edge order i=0..7; no cancellation
selection: within each point,L select minimum energy only; recommend smallest L with >=2/3 joint pass and energy-best passing
budget: 180 main runs + at most 45 fallback runs; no hidden restarts; pilot reused if same hashes
